import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, ax=ax1, palette='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AlterVHundSort'].first().sort_values().index
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
colors = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_counts))
ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby(['KreisLang', 'KreisSort']).size().reset_index(name='count').sort_values('KreisSort')
sns.barplot(x='KreisLang', y='count', data=district_counts, ax=ax3, palette='Set2')
ax3.set_xlabel('District (Kreis)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution Across Zurich Districts', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Owner Age vs Dog Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
owner_dog_df = df.groupby(['AlterV10Lang', 'SexHundLang', 'AlterV10Sort']).size().reset_index(name='count')
owner_dog_df = owner_dog_df.sort_values('AlterV10Sort')
owner_age_order = owner_dog_df['AlterV10Lang'].unique()

# Pivot for stacked bar
pivot_df = owner_dog_df.pivot_table(index='AlterV10Lang', columns='SexHundLang', values='count', fill_value=0)
pivot_df = pivot_df.reindex(owner_age_order)

pivot_df.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=8)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
